title: Anthropic Managed Agents for Long-Running AI Workflows
summary: Anthropic Managed Agents provides a hosted infrastructure for long-running, autonomous AI workflows with native state management and tool integration. It handles sandboxing, credential vaulting, and persistent memory to enable complex multi-step task execution.
research_notes: Uses a metered 'Agent Credit' billing system with a $0.08 hourly session fee in addition to standard token usage rates.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from an experimental engineering prototype to a production-ready enterprise suite featuring 'Dreaming' memory optimization and 'Outcomes' auto-correction. Now natively integrated with Claude 4.7 models for persistent, autonomous orchestration.
